model.ownership: Single global owner; shared references do not grant cross-Agent business reads

implementation: Explicit reference authority (ready/changing/unknown/revoked), versioned operations and immutable owner reviews; audit no longer substitutes for business state.

Mutation intent, reference changing, model/delivery revocation and audit commit atomically before native I/O. Boot/token/epoch checked before dispatch and settlement; terminal observations cannot be rewritten.
Model authorization and delivery approval/claim/start share the same reference gate. Saving configurations or registering an existing reference cannot reset unknown/revoked authority.
Four owned changes/reviews; cancellations keep actual operations owned and block teardown. Active changes cannot be reviewed or reclaimed by the live boot.
Owner review binds full UUID, revision, epoch, policy and current-operation fingerprint. It changes only future authority and never rewrites historical unknown operations or model fees.

Normal restart distinguishes prepared from running and never replays; restored snapshots invalidate all credential authorities and owner tokens, increase epochs, retain prior reviews and require new verification.

Frozen transactional v10 migration quarantines v9 configuration/hash-only references without importing V1 or native keys; audit sequence high-water retained; forced process death rolls DDL/data back together.
Native OS usernames use the same reference hash as domain/vault, preserving case-sensitive aliases even on case-insensitive native backends. Validation uses injected fake native classes only.

Owner-only bounded HTTP list/operation/review queries; execution tokens and key values excluded. Configuration diagnosis reports authority blocks; review log operation ID matches durable review identity.
Workbench own resources v15, review/history, reference registration and corrected credential save/delete API. Four widths and two themes; no extra polling; status fingerprints wrap on mobile.

Playwright fieldset disabled semantics differ from form controls; assert actual review submit button disabled.
Found actual narrow-screen status hash overflow; added status wrapping, keeping viewport assertion.

Own-resource cache edits changed newline formatting; ran pinned formatter. Typed diagnosis guard added before accessing JSON payload. No ignored errors or relaxed checks.
